supersedes.method: An exhaustive per-field ledger replaces v6 common/direct prose. Each listed field occurrence has exactly one disposition; only explicit operands may be compared.

tuple.rule: Exactly eleven positional type(bytes) values. Bootstrap root/phase bytes equal. Scope-action phase=stage-consumer and replay-pre-final phase=replay-consumer; there is no equality or inequality relation between root and phase PIS in either case.

retained_v6_exact_contract.canonical: type(raw) is bytes; UTF-8 strict; json.loads with constants and duplicate object keys refused; recursively only dict[str,*],list,str,None,bool,int,finite float; canonical json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False).encode('ascii') must equal raw; all closed shapes refuse null/float.
retained_v6_exact_contract.byte_comparator: B compares unsigned octets left-to-right; first lower wins, prefix shorter wins, equality ties. K(x)=canonical bytes; K(tuple)=canonical bytes of ordered list. Strict sort means adjacent B(K)<0. CES uses complete canonical item B; CAS uses planned_entry_sha256 B(K) then complete PCE B; every sort RED includes z and U+00E9 serialized as \u00e9.
retained_v6_exact_contract.self_signature: unsigned self omits exactly self; signed self/preimage omits exactly named self and signature; SHA-256(preimage)=self and exact signature string/preimage are passed to public ReleaseKeyring.verify(key_id,key_version,issued_at_ms,preimage,signature).
retained_v6_exact_contract.suffix: Every signed envelope has exactly issuance_basis_sha256,issuer_role,key_usage,signature_alg:Ed25519,issued_at_ms,not_before_ms,expires_at_ms,revocation_snapshot_sha256,key:{key_id,key_version},named self,signature; not_before<=issued<=expires; one inclusive TrustedClock instant; keyring and HistoricalStudyRevocations must return built-in True.
